confidence: PROV/[WRS]. A real worn WHOOP 4.0 historical DSP record (type 47, version 24) from tanarchytan/whoop-rs, committed with only biometrics + timestamp. The offsets reproduce the author's pinned expects byte-for-byte (HR 109 body[14], R-R 555/564 body[15..], gravity |g|=1.06 three f32 from body[33], SpO2 red 592/ir 612 raw ADC body[61]/[63], skin-temp register 861 body[65:67], respiration 3073 body[73:75]). The bytes are real, but the 4.0 offload path is not yet exercised on our own hardware and the absolute skin-temp scale stays a per-device learned anchor (deferred, ADR-009), so treat physiological calibration as unproven; the decode itself is pinned.
